propositions: A primary comment-dedup guard (binding_store.is_comment_mapped) was inert in production for the entire 6-day feature lifespan because comment_ids map in .bridge_state/bindings.json was never populated, until aa7b's fix landed.

The primary skip failed silently with no logging or metrics; a working secondary body-equality fallback absorbed enough traffic to mask total primary-path failure as partial success or flakiness, particularly on short comments.

No pre-fix test exercises the primary dedup path end-to-end across the seam between transport response, recording, and re-diffing; each layer's tests seed the invariant the other layer establishes, making all 26 passing tests compatible with is_comment_mapped hard-wired to False.

Plan-review criteria E4, T3, and T5b each abstain or stop just short of the fail-open silent-guard hazard class; code-review guidance to detect it was added post-escape via commit 4c57247ff88, after the operator rejected a new criterion.

Production observability did not surface the invariant violation (comment_ids remained empty while bindings grew to 2475+ and comment posts succeeded), exposing a gap in operation-linked alerting distinct from review-time rubrics.
